mechanism: Naloxone's opioid antagonism may precipitate withdrawal symptoms in patients on chronic opioids who are also taking atomoxetine (a noradrenergic agent), and atomoxetine may increase cardiovascular effects during acute opioid reversal.
action: Monitor vital signs closely during naloxone administration in patients on atomoxetine; assess for opioid dependence status before naloxone use and manage potential withdrawal symptoms appropriately.
